text:
Sarah (Partnerships): Hey team — finalizing the cloud marketplace packaging for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need a quick read on SKU tiers, trial activation flow, and legal attachments so we can flip the switch this week.
Maria (Product): Posting the SKU matrix I put together. tiers: Free-trial, Starter, Pro, Enterprise. Starter/Pro are metered by inference-hours, Enterprise is reserved capacity. Questions: do we map Starter->monthly and Pro->usage-based on marketplaces? :thinking_face:
Ivan (Legal): @Maria we should avoid usage-based billing on Marketplace for Starter unless we include pricing caps in the contract. Also need localized EULA and DPA stub attached to the offer. I can draft the marketplace-specific addendum.
Alex (DevRel): For launch assets I need a 1-paragraph product blurb + 3 screenshots + a short 'how to test' doc. I'll draft the blurb if someone drops the key bullets.
Jen (Eng): To validate listings we need a test AMI/VM image for GCP and Azure VM image + an IAM role with readonly listing access for the marketplace QA team. I just created a staging role; deploying a small smoke image now.
AWS Marketplace Bot: Role assignment complete. access_role: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/marketplace-staging. (automated)
Maria (Product): Key bullets: low-latency inference runtime, autoscaling dedicated pools, token-level cost breakdowns, private deployment option. Screenshots: Console routing policy, cost dashboard, rollout UI.
Sarah (Partnerships): @Ivan can you confirm if the DPA stub needs customer signature during marketplace purchase flow or if we can link to it and capture acceptance via a checkbox? That affects onboarding steps.
Ivan (Legal): Marketplace checkbox is OK for standard customers but Enterprise (reserved capacity) requires an executed SOW. I'll prepare the SOW template and the checkbox copy for the listing.
Jen (Eng): Quick test snippet for QA to call the staged listing endpoint:
```
# smoke test
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  https://staging-marketplace.redwood-example.com/v1/infer \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello"}'
```
Alex (DevRel): I'll add that snippet to the verification doc and create a one-click Postman collection. Also planning a short walkthrough video for partners.
Maria (Product): One more: trial activation. Marketplace passes a tenant token; we map that to a 14-day trial in our onboarding. Do we need to handle multiple trial grants per customer? Probably block duplicates.
Ivan (Legal): Blocking duplicate trials is fine; ensure it's in the terms. Also confirm export control language for inference logs — some marketplaces require specific disclosures.
Sarah (Partnerships): Ops checklist for launch: 1) legal artifacts uploaded, 2) SKU pricing table mapped, 3) images/docs, 4) QA smoke pass, 5) launch blog draft. Who owns blog?
Alex (DevRel): I can own the blog with Marketing review. Suggest timeline: blog draft by Tue, marketplace publish Wed/Fri depending on approvals.
Jen (Eng): QA ETA: smoke pass by EOD tomorrow if no blockers with staging account.
Ivan (Legal): I'll upload the EULA/DPA drafts to the drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/marketplace/legal/packaging-v1
Maria (Product): Uploading SKU CSV and the manifest example. Manifest quick example below:
```
listing_manifest:
  product: redwood-inference
  skus:
    - id: redwood-starter
      price: 49.00
      billing: monthly
    - id: redwood-pro
      price: pay-as-you-go
      billing: usage
    - id: redwood-enterprise
      price: contact-sales
      billing: reserved
  trial_days: 14
```
Sarah (Partnerships): Great progress. Next steps: Ivan finalize legal addendum by EOD Monday, Maria confirm SKU mapping to each cloud portal, Jen complete QA smoke by tomorrow, Alex drafts blog and assets. If all green we'll submit AWS/GCP/Azure packages Wed. :party_parrot:
